column1: # Canonical UCI <-> upstream option schema for cake-autorate 3.2.2.
# Generated from defaults.sh at the pinned tag plus docs/upstream-option-inventory.md;
# type:      integer | float | bool | string | list  (upstream `typeof` class;
#            bool is an integer restricted to 0/1, list is a bash array literal)
# managed:   user    - free for the user to set
#            bounded - user-settable, bridge must clamp to a sane non-zero range
#            forced  - bridge overwrites unconditionally with uci_default
# essential: yes -> shown in the LuCI Essentials group; a fresh instance needs
#            only these edited to be a working configuration
